items.change: The party arrived at Brandonsford following a treasure map whose marked locations they did not recognize.
items.impact_basis: The opening beat sets up the party's motivating goal of finding the treasure via an unfamiliar map.
items.lasting_basis: The map's unknown locations and treasure remain the party's reason for being here and will drive later exploration.

items.change: Reginald warned the party that a trickster Clurichen comes into town from the riverbanks every night.
items.impact_basis: A single warning introduces a new nightly danger but nothing has happened with it yet.
items.lasting_basis: The creature is said to come nightly, and Sir Phidipaldi already invoked Clurichens, so it is likely to come up again.

items.change: The party learned a black dragon troubles Brandonsford and Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold to whoever kills it and brings back its body.
items.impact_basis: Eric's 1000-gold offer, George's lost arm, and Farmer Gill's account of the old dragon and his hunting sons establish a major foe and a new main goal.
items.lasting_basis: The dragon still lives with a large bounty and rival hunters in the field, so it will shape later Sessions.

items.change: Lady Hilda offered to join the party against the dragon for pay, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would return to hire her.
items.impact_basis: A seasoned potential ally made an offer and the party signalled intent to accept, but no deal is struck.
items.lasting_basis: Sir Phidipaldi promised to come back for her services, so the hire is likely to come up again.

items.change: Drop Dead Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold a week, and Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.
items.impact_basis: A dangerous potential hireling made a concrete offer that remains undecided.
items.lasting_basis: Dr. Uriah is still considering the offer, so Ned is likely to reappear.

items.change: The party learned no shipments have reached Brandonsford in months, starving the town of goods, for an unknown reason.
items.impact_basis: Bentley's and Gill's accounts reveal a town-wide supply problem, a significant discovery tied to the dragon.
items.lasting_basis: The unexplained cause is an open mystery likely to be investigated later.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi insulted Eric the Reeve and challenged him to a duel at dawn, and Bentley sent him to the Golden Egg for the night.
items.impact_basis: The glove slap and duel challenge soured relations with the bounty-giver and got Sir Phidipaldi expelled from the tavern.
items.lasting_basis: The dawn duel is unresolved and the quarrel with the Reeve who holds the bounty will likely carry into the next Session.

items.change: Farmer Gill offered Dunk his mule Shamus for 100 gold, and Dunk is sleeping in Gill's barn to consider trading work instead.
items.impact_basis: An offer of an ordinary mount was made and not yet accepted.
items.lasting_basis: Dunk is sleeping on the offer, so it will probably be settled soon but is minor.

items.change: The party learned Warwick the smith displays a superb mithril chain shirt that he refuses to sell.
items.impact_basis: A single beat reveals a coveted item that is out of reach.
items.lasting_basis: It may tempt the party later, but nothing has been set in motion.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage a fake ale delivery for Quinn for 100 gold to get back at Bentley.
items.impact_basis: An agreement was made for paid work, while Quinn's account of nightly vanishing stock adds a mystery.
items.lasting_basis: The staged delivery has not yet happened and is likely to play out in a later Session.
